summary: DreamFactory and Square's 3D fighting series, including Tobal No. 1, the Japan-only Tobal 2, and the Japan-only mobile revival Tobal M.

entries.title: Tobal No. 1

emulation.notes: Use original aspect ratio and conservative enhancement options for the cleanest capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with high-quality PS1 emulation.

primary.why: Tobal No. 1 has no sourced modern remaster; the original PlayStation release is the complete version, with high-quality PS1 emulation providing the best capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PlayStation disc or image through DuckStation with conservative enhancement settings.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate release or exclusive-content split.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster or re-release.

entries.title: Tobal 2

emulation.notes: Use owned-disc PS1 emulation for capture and input consistency.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with high-quality PS1 emulation.

primary.why: Tobal 2 was released only in Japan on PlayStation, with a later Legendary Hits reprint but no sourced modern remaster; the original PS1 version is the complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Japanese PlayStation disc or image through DuckStation. Fan translation is a non-official accessibility layer if needed, but the archive pick remains the original Japanese release.

all_releases.reason: skip: reprint of the same PlayStation game, not a different gameplay version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate version with exclusive game content.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster; original release was not localized for North America or PAL regions.

entries.title: Tobal M

emulation.emulator: Original compatible Japanese mobile hardware/service environment; preservation emulation if available
emulation.notes: No current official route is sourced.

primary.why: Tobal M is a Japan-only mobile-phone entry in the Tobal series with no sourced modern port, so the original mobile release is the only documented version.
primary.how_to_play: No current official consumer route is sourced; treat it as a preservation/documentation target unless a compatible archived mobile build and hardware environment are available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern re-release; practical play access is preservation-dependent.
